vehicles.slot: Selector surround panel (trim around the shifter base — shows P R N D). Lift the surround panel upward at the 'D' position to expose the small interlock cam on the right side of the shift lever. (lift selector surround panel — 1-series has compact console)
shift: Turn ignition to ON (position 2 — do not start).
Locate the SELECTOR SURROUND — the trim panel around the gear selector base (shows P R N D markings).
Slide a finger under the lip of the surround at the 'D' position and lift FIRMLY upward — it pops off.
With the surround removed, look for a small CAM or lever on the RIGHT side of the shift lever shaft.
Use a small flathead screwdriver to lift the cam UPWARD — this releases the shift interlock.
While holding the cam up, press the brake pedal firmly.
Move the selector to Neutral.
You can now start the car in N or proceed with towing.
neutral: Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
BATTERY IS IN THE TRUNK — use REMOTE (+) terminal under hood (driver side, red cover).
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
If power cannot be restored, use the shift lock slot above — Slot at base of gear selector on center console.
vehicles.notes: Manual: depress clutch, select N — no shift lock.
vehicles.towMethod: Lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
